column2: Subject  to  the  provisions  of  this Act  and  any  other

column1: written law, the Corporation shall have the power to—

column2: rent  out  lands  and  buildings  belonging  to  the
Corporation in order to achieve the objects of the
Corporation;
raise funds and accept donations and gifts either in
cash or materials;
construct  or  cause  to  construct  buildings  on  any
land belonging to the Corporation ;
make,  write,  accept,  discount,  counter  sign,
negotiate, purchase, sell and issue Bills of Exchange,
Cheques, Promissory notes and any other negotiable
instrument and to open, operate and maintain Current
and Savings Bank account in any Bank ;
invest the funds of the Corporation which are not
immediately  required  for  the  purposes  of  the
Corporation;
accept, operate, fulfil and manage any lawful trust
and  conditions  with  regard  to  movable  and
immovable properties ;
appoint,  remunerate,  employ  and  dismiss  officers
and  servants  of  the  Corporation  required  for  the
carrying out of the objects of the Corporation; and
train  persons  required  for  the  achievement  of  the
objects of the Corporation.
